notes.title: 10/22 | Update News
notes.content:
Greetings to all Dusk Diver players!

Dusk Diver is now celebrating its first anniversary today!
Thank you very much for your encouragement and attention throughout this year. All of your comments, live videos and game reviews are very valuable and supportive to us.

10/22 Detailed update:
1.	Russian version is now released.
We are excited to share this news - Dusk Diver is now supporting Russian! For those who have purchased Dusk Diver on Steam, the language preference will be updated automatically.
Special thanks to: Russian localization service provider, FaceOff Team. 
On top of their professional gaming localization experience in Russian, they can also help designing Russian fonts that align with the game. FaceOff team is highly recommended if related services are required.

2.	The special outfit "Where is my jacket?" given to Early Access players a year ago is now available to everyone.

3.	Other minor bugs fixes.


Thank you again for your support in the previous year.

notes.title: 10/24 | Words from producer
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 
This is the producer of Dusk Diver, Lancelot Chu.

Dusk Diver has officially released today, and I gratefully appreciate all supports from our players.
We have received several bugs reports, and I am very glad for all the helps we received.
Our team is currently addressing the issues immediately, and we hope to solve them as soon as possible.

The most frequent incidents are listed below：

1. There will be chances of that the screen will freeze during the loading stage after the logo presentation.
A. The problem has already resolved in the new update.
B. If the freeze still occurs after update, emergency measures: In the Task Manager, close Dusk Diver in the running execution, and then restart the game. (Or directly restart the PC to avoid this problem.)

2. The tutorial text in English version is garbled.
A. The text in“Combo Bonus” has already fixed in the new update.

3. Incorrect display with monitors that are not with a ratio of 16:9.
A. Now there are more resolution options to choose from in the new update.


Besides, there will be some bugs while using previous save files from Early Access :

1.	The all new function cannot work
A. We hope all players could experience the new Dusk Diver, so the save files from Early Access will be denied in the incoming update.

2. There might be issues while playing the voice lines.
A. Please re-select the language of the voice in the Option on the title screen.

3. Can’t acquire the Early Access special outfit “Where Is My Jacket?”
A. After having a“New Game”save files, restart the game to receive the outfit.

Our deepest apology that we the problems were not addressed prior to the official release of the game.
We will continue to optimize the content. Thank you again for your support.

notes.title: Official version update content announcement & initial discount
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It has been almost half a year since Dusk Diver’s early access started on March 26th. In the past six months, we have been busy updating the content of the game, at the same time preparing for the transfer of the console version, all of which has gradually come to a close, so we have some announcements for everyone!！


[h1][b]Official release date[/b][/h1]
Dusk Diver will be out of early access on October 24th and will be officially launched on the three platforms Steam, PS4 and Nintendo Switch!


[h1][b]Price increase & initial discount[/b][/h1]
Because it is going to be officially launched, the price will be raised permanently after release. From today until September 26th, an initial discount of 25% off is being offered, if you plan to enter Dusk Diver or gift someone, now is a good opportunity to do it!


[h1][b]New content[/b][/h1]
[b]◆New Exploration system[/b]
• "Link Quest" system added, you can accept quests from people who are in trouble in Ximending, solve their problems, and be rewarded with quest rewards like "Yumo's Daily photo" and "Special Clothings"...
•"Gacha machine" added, use the Gacha machine in the game to get the "Concept Arts" and " Clothing Color-Changer".』
• " Mazu Temple Lottery" added, in addition to getting "Pottery Lottery", it occasionally brings you luck in battle
• "Gallery" feature added, you can now enjoy all the content you have collected in game.

[b]◆Whole new combat system[/b]
• "Shift menu" added, a portion of the summoning attack can be used directly with button combos!
•Recovery item now also use the "Shift Menu", and the type of items that can be equipped at one time is increased to 4 types.
• D Arms Trigger is also changed to use the "Shift menu" to activate
• Guardian characteristics adjustment
Leo: Increases attack damage and has the ability to reduce special armor, making damage output more stable
Le viada: attacks can ignore enemy special armor and inflict direct damage.
Bahet: cancels out the enemy's special armor recovery ability, to more effectively eliminate large groups of enemies

[b]◆Combat related adjustment[/b]
• Re-adjustments to the protagonist group stats & enemy stats to improve the balance between the two difficulty levels on Normal/Hard
• Adjustments to enemy AI, additional attack moves added to some enemies
• Re-adjustments to enemies in all levels
• Adjust how combat lock-on works to improve the problem of unspecified attack directions for Guardians
• 『Combo Buff』Stat adjustments to improve the rhythm of the overall battle

[b]◆Sound related addition[/b]
• Adding full Chinese/Japanese VO for main story events
• Adding 2 additional battle BGMs and 1 additional exploration BGM
• Additions and adjustments to the protagonist group’s combat dialogue 
• Adding an insert song by Nemea’s VA Kate Mizukiri (Music: Shade)

[b]◆Performance optimization[/b]
• Unlock 60fps mode
• Unlock detailed graphical quality adjustment, now you can freely adjust the display method to suit your own hardware!

[b]◆Overall game pacing adjustment[/b]
• System unlock pacing adjustment (adjustments to minor parts of the plot)
• Redistribution of protagonist enhancement points
• Money acquisition probability & store sold item price adjustment
• Guardian bond Lv growth rate adjustment
• Adding a "running" mechanic to the real world Ximending that allows the protagonist to immediately enter the running state.
• Additional tutorial content, additional static tutorials to portions lacking in the early access version

[b]◆UI optimization[/b]
• UI visual adjustment
• Map Icon adjustment
• Shorten the delay time between menus
• Visual adjustment to the combat report menu to make items collected more obvious
• The button prompt column is fully adjusted, so that all interface operations have enough prompts
• Improve item equipment operation to match the increase number of recovery items equipped at the same time

[b]◆Misc[/b]
• Corresponding Steam cloud save function

[h1][b]Hot Fix [/b][/h1]
• Some achievements cannot be completed
• Occasionally getting stuck in the battle, unable to act
• Some backgrounds pop out
• Other minor bug fixes and optimizations


[h1][b]Exclusive Steam Version content[/b][/h1]
• Adding a fourth character "Boss" (will be updated to the game for free 1 month after release.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34144778/7ddda88465c0c41a4506e30419794f4a58927aa1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Additional Special Clothing[/b][/h1]
•The dressing room preset clothing adds the "Go Go Rise costumes" (extra DLC during the early access version) and the new clothing set "School uniforms" selected by the player vote

After seeing so much new content updates, aren’t you a little convinced? Why not heading over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/911220/Dusk_Diver/]store page[/url] right now!

notes.title: Words from producer
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Dusk Diver has started the Early Access almost five months. We would like to thank all the players who participated in the Early Access and gave us advice. Every feedback has been read and considered.

Today, the game producer specially recorded a video for all players, please click the link below to watch:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gJLIvTfZtAI

[h1][b]The spiritual journey of game development[/b][/h1]
As a game creator, I think there are others like me,
I am very drawn to representations of locations like Tokyo and Osaka in games and New York and Hollywood in movies.
Being able to incorporate the scenery around you into a game is indeed a very exciting thing.

And because this game is set in Taipei Ximending, it's a game with a Taiwanese high school girl as its main character,
Therefore, it naturally receives attention from the domestic player base and the media.
This has made the production team feel very on edge, hoping to live up to everyone’s expectations.
Finally, I hope that I can let players from overseas enjoy this game.

《Dusk Diver》was released in March this year on Steam's Early Access.
In the past six months, we have received encouragement from many players, as well as feedback.
The official version of the game will be available for sale on Steam, PlayStation 4, and Nintendo Switch on October 24th this year,
the adjustments to the game are nearing its end, let's take a look at the problems that most players are interested in.

[h1][b]Q1. Only partial main storyline has voice dubbing[/b][/h1]
Many players have stated before, in the main storyline
some portion are dubbed, where others are not, which makes some segments very jarring.
In order to improve this, we have carried out an immediate second round of dubbing.
In all the mainline stories and most of the substories, plot segments will now be presented with full voice acting.
Many players have also stated that the combat dialogue was too monotonous and boring,
we have now made substantial adjustments and additions.

[h1][b]Q2. Lack of monster type diversities and their designed AI, resulting a dull gaming experience[/b][/h1]
Regarding the lack of monster variety, we have reviewed all the stage levels and made modifications to the enemy configuration,
adding a small amount of new monsters, maybe not a substantial additional
But we have made overall adjustments to the AI's move set usage and attack values.
I believe that in the official version, all monsters will have more distinctive characteristics, so stay tuned.

[h1][b]Q3. It is a regret that we can only eat cuisine and search for Dragon Vein Stone in the great Ximending[/b][/h1]
As for the lack of things to do in Ximending, this has also been something that the production team felt was surely lacking.
After our careful evaluation and discussion, we have added a new system to the official version to make up for this shortcoming.
However, regarding the content of this system, it will take a little while before we can explain it to you, please look forward to it and have a little patience.

Previously, the console exclusive Guardian Nemea was announced for the home console version
But Steam players don't have to worry, Steam will also getting its own exclusive content.
Please continue to support Dusk Diver

▼Watch more▼
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gJLIvTfZtAI][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34144778/35d57b7c74d8da663ba82b47f5ca605669ae5317.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: 4/2 update announcement │Words from development team
notes.content:
Since the release of Dusk Diver, the team received many support and feedback from the players. In order to deliver better playing experience, the game will be continuously optimized base on the players' feedback and suggestions. 

Some players reported the game could not be set at 60 FPS, the reason behind it was to provide a smoother game play. The current version is at a maximum of 30 FPS, however, 60 FPS option will be available in the future optimized patch. 

Detailed update:
◆ General update
   •  8 New Steam achievements
   •  Newly added Yumo and Guardians skill list in the tutorial

◆ Changes 
   •  Open Main Menu button has been changed from Backspce to Esc 
   •  You can now press alt+Enter to switch between fullscreen mode and windows mode

Development Team Notes: For a better gaming experience, the game control has been improved. 

◆ Fixes 
   •  steamgame client startup error fixed
   •  Stuck at Chapter 6 main story line fixed
   •  In-game bugs fixed

Development Team Notes: 
1.Some players encountered the problems that the game cannot be successfully launched. This particular issue has already been addressed, please update the game to the latest version.

2.Fixed a problem occurred in chapter 6 main story line, exiting the convenient store in the stage would prevent the player from entering again. Now players can enter and exit freely in chapter 6. If the above issue had occurred, and the game has not yet been saved manually or has not yet accepted another quest, simply load the previous save to continue your journey. Otherwise, you need to load a save file before the incident to continue the chapter 6 main line.  We apologize for any inconvenience caused to the players><

notes.title: Free for trial
notes.content:
Free for trial now

- Frequently asked questions-

Q1.Can I livestream or share the gameplay video of the trial version?
A： Yes, absolutely.

2.What platforms are you going to release the game? 
A：We plan to release "Dusk Diver" on PC Steam and Nintendo Switch.
However, the trial version is only on PC for now.

3.What is the minimum/recommended specifications for "Dusk Diver"?
A：Please refer to the products introduction on the official webpage：https://duskdiver.jfigames.com/index_en.html

Q4.What should I do if the game forced shut down or cannot be started correctly?
A：Please check the specifications of your PC first to see if it meets the minimum requirement. If there is any other problems, please send message through official Facebook.
Official webpage：https://duskdiver.jfigames.com/index_en.html
Official Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/DuskDiver/

Q5. About the controller
A：For the trial version, if you use PS4 controller you have to install the driver first, Xbox controller can use directly without any settings.
(For the future release version, if you start the game in Windows10+Steam, you don't need any settings for PS4 controller)

Q6. About OS
A： The trial version can run correctly in Windows7 and newer OS.

Q7. What should I do if there is a color flickering in full screen mode?
Solution：
(1) Open NVIDIA control panel.
(2) Apply NVIDIA color setting.
Reference：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6o3slx1jkqk
